ellie (PM): Quick thread — we need to finalize DP recruitment approach today. Two clear asks from partners: guarantee deeper private installs for a few strategic customers, or maximize sample diversity with a larger light cohort. Which minimizes product risk but gives actionable signal?

kai (Eng): Technical reality: deep private installs (VPC + SSO + admin UI) = ~3 sprints. Light cohort (telemetry + runbook + 2 office hours) = ~1 sprint. If we overcommit on deep we block infra roadmap.

ravi (Solutions): Sales: two partners insist on private installs; others are happy with light. Suggest hybrid: run 7-light by default and reserve 2 deep seats for invite-only.

maya (ProdResearch): From measurement POV, more partners increases prompt surface area which is valuable early. But deep seats are needed to validate VPC workflows. Recommend telemetry mandatory for all.

zoe (Legal): Flag: any private deploy requires a short addendum (data handling + indemnity cap). I can produce a 1-pager in 48h; we should add a telemetry consent checkbox.

ellie (PM): Proposed plan: Default track = "Broad" (7 light seats). Reserved track = "Deep" (2 seats). Acceptance gates for Broad: 1) signed pilot terms; 2) telemetry hook active (req_id + sampled_payload + response_hash); 3) smoke request within 72h; 4) <=2 high-sev regressions across cohort. Deep additional gate: SSO config + sample VPC manifest delivered prior to cutover.

kai (Eng): Implementation notes: telemetry hook = lightweight SDK + server flag (1 sprint). Deep work = VPC orchestration + UI (3 sprints). Fallback if deep slips: offer affected partners the Broad track + priority support or postpone their deep seat to next cohort. Add latency SLO: p50 < 150ms OR auto-route to hosted variant.

ravi (Solutions): I'll add an intake checkbox "apply for deep seat" and a short priority field. Also draft invite language that clearly explains tracks and fallback options.

maya (ProdResearch): Measurement plan (short): onboard_time (days), active_requests/week, eval_regressions, partner_sat (0-10). I'll create T+2 and T+6 survey templates and a dashboard slice for these metrics.

zoe (Legal): I'll draft the pilot addendum and a short privacy blurb. Recommend we include an anonymized telemetry clause and liability cap.

ops-bot: Reminder: DP staging deploy scheduled 2025-03-14T10:00Z (1798124400). Toggle migrations if needed.

ellie (PM): Action items: Ravi -> intake checkbox + invite copy by EOD. Kai -> telemetry estimate + fallback plan by Tue. Maya -> surveys + dashboard slice by Wed. Zoe -> addendum draft by Wed. We'll ratify in Thu sync. :white_check_mark:
